subject: general
question: Bleaching powder is a compound of which of the following elements?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Calcium__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Bleaching powder is **yellowish** powder **soluble in water**.
 
• **Calcium hypochlorite** is known as **bleaching powder.**
 
• **Formula- CaOCl₂ **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• It has a **strong smell of chlorine.**
 
• **Uses:**
 
 
• Used in **bleaching clothes** in the laundry
 
• Used in **bleaching of cotton and linen **in textile industries.
 
• Used as **an oxidizing agent.**
 
• used as a **disinfectant** for disinfecting water.
 
• Used as a **bathroom cleaner**
 
 
 
• **Preparation**- **Ca(OH)₂ + Cl₂ → CaOCl₂ + H₂O**
 
• An **oxidizing agent** is a substance that **oxidizes other substances** i.e. It **makes them lose their electrons.**
 
• An **oxidizing agent** has the** ability to accept electrons** from others. ** **
